results.name: Wrong answer submission (201) returns a server-computed score, not a client-trusted one
Server awards the real, existing session-linked XP amount (seed-soil = 75)
A second attempt at an already-scored quiz module is honestly rejected as already-scored, XP not re-granted
Player state XP total reflects exactly one grant of the quiz XP, not two
A genuinely perfect answer set scores 5/5 server-side
Perfect score grants the tiered 125 XP (not a client-fabricated amount)
Perfect score grants both the botanist AND leaf-scholar badges
Perfect score grants the leaf-recognition Passport stamp
An all-wrong answer set is scored 0/5 server-side, never trusting a claimed high score
A 0-score attempt does not grant the leaf-scholar badge
Re-submitting Leaf Challenge with a DIFFERENT (better) answer set after a first attempt is rejected — first real attempt is final, not farmable
A real named XP source (art-observation) is granted its server-approved amount (50)
An unknown/fabricated named XP source is rejected with 400, never silently granted
The same named XP source cannot be granted twice to the same guest, even under a different idempotency key
A direct-award Origins badge (art-appreciation) is granted server-side
The same badge cannot be granted twice under a different idempotency key
A plain guest identity attempting a correction is rejected (403), never applied
Both concurrent requests return well-formed success (no 500)
A two-tab race on the same quiz module grants XP exactly once, not twice
